name: Ireland
about: Mild and rainy much of the year, like the rest of the British Isles — no real closed season, though Jul–Aug brings the best odds of dry weather for the Wild Atlantic Way.
overview: Dublin's pub culture and literary history, paired with the dramatic Atlantic coastline of the Wild Atlantic Way — Cliffs of Moher, Ring of Kerry, Dingle.
costOverview: Pub food and a pint stay reasonable outside Dublin's tourist core — Dublin itself runs noticeably pricier than the rest of the country.
